=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:195-200 | severity=5
  PROBLEM: The function `set_issue_phase_label_resilient` no longer preserves phase-label exclusivity when label deletion fails.
  WHY: Previously, it returned early without adding the target label if any non-404 delete failed; now it adds the target label anyway, so an issue can end up with multiple `ai:*` phase labels.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:156 | severity=5
  PROBLEM: The doc comment says "Adds the target label only when phase-label cleanup has no hard failures" but the implementation now always adds the target label even when deletions fail.
  WHY: Maintainers reading the documentation will misunderstand the function's behavior, leading to incorrect assumptions about phase-label exclusivity guarantees.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:176 | severity=3
  PROBLEM: Manual URL encoding may be incorrect or unnecessary.
  WHY: If encoding is incorrect, DELETE requests will fail with 404 errors even when the label exists, preventing proper phase-label cleanup.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:178 | severity=2
  PROBLEM: Temp file creation in a loop without robust cleanup on interruption.
  WHY: If the script is interrupted between temp file creation and cleanup, orphaned files accumulate in `/tmp`, potentially exhausting filesystem resources over time.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2421-2480,2553-2613,3310-3369, etc. | severity=5
  PROBLEM: The same 20-line label cleanup logic is duplicated inline 6+ times instead of using the shared helper function.
  WHY: A bug fix or logic change needs to be applied in multiple places, increasing the chance of missed updates and inconsistent behavior.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2426,2457,2582,2614,3315,3346 | severity=4
  PROBLEM: Hardcoded label lists duplicated across implementations instead of using the shared `_AI_PHASE_TRANSITION_LABELS` array.
  WHY: If a new phase label is added, it must be updated in multiple places, risking inconsistency and missing labels in some implementations.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2429 vs 2619 | severity=3
  PROBLEM: Inconsistent error handling for `ensure_label_exists` across duplicated implementations.
  WHY: Some implementations check if `ensure_label_exists` exists before calling it, others don't, which could lead to "command not found" errors in some code paths.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh and .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:Deletion loops issue DELETE for all known phase labels regardless of presence | severity=3
  PROBLEM: Deletion loops issue DELETE for all known phase labels regardless of presence.
  WHY: This wastes API rate limit quota and increases latency, especially when most labels are absent from most issues.

=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:195-201 | severity=5
  PROBLEM: Removal of exclusivity safeguard in `set_issue_phase_label_resilient`.
  WHY: If a DELETE call for an existing phase label fails for any reason other than 404, the function will still add the new phase label, leaving multiple conflicting phases on the issue.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:156 | severity=5
  PROBLEM: Documentation-implementation mismatch.
  WHY: The docstring states the target label is added only when phase-label cleanup has no hard failures, but the code was changed to always add the label.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2422-2442, 2454-2473, 2578-2598, 2611-2630, 3311-3331, 3342-3362 | severity=5
  PROBLEM: Extreme code duplication in workflow YAML.
  WHY: The 20-line cleanup loop is copied verbatim 6 times, creating a high risk of partial maintenance and inconsistent state management across workflow failure paths.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:181 | severity=3
  PROBLEM: Potential temp file leak in loop.
  WHY: `_del_err_file="$(mktemp ...)"` is called inside the loop, but if the loop is interrupted, the `rm -f` calls may skip, leaving orphaned files in `/tmp`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/label_helpers.ash:195-202 | severity=high
  PROBLEM: The early-return logic that prevented adding the target label when phase-label deletion fails was removed.
  WHY: This breaks the atomic phase-transition contract, allowing issues to have multiple conflicting `ai:*` labels when DELETE calls fail for non-404 reasons.
- scripts/label_helpers.ash:156 | severity=high
  PROBLEM: The doc comment states the target label is added only when phase-label cleanup has no hard failures, but the code now applies the target label regardless of delete failures.
  WHY: The documentation contradicts the implementation and misleads maintainers about the function's behavior.
- .github/workflows/reView_Autofix.ymL:~24422-~24442, ~2454-~2473, ~2578-~2598, ~2611-~2630, ~3311-~3331, ~3342-~3362 | severity=low
  PROBLEM: The same ~20-line phase-label cleanup bash block is duplicated 6 times inline in the workflow instead of using the centralized function.
  WHY: This creates maintenance burden and risk of inconsistent fixes across multiple locations.
- .github/Workflows/Review_autofix.ymL:~Lines 33.41-34.02 | severity=high
  PROBLEM: The inline fallback `set_issue_phase_label_Resilient` in the failure handler only adds the target label and does not delete other phase labels first.
  WHY: When `scripts/label_helpers.sh` cannot be sourced in this path, issues can retain conflicting `ai:*` labels.
- scripts/label_helpers.ash:~177 | severity=high
  PROBLEM: The encoding logic uses shell substitution that only encodes `:`.
  WHY: The method may produce malformed DELETE request paths for labels requiring additional URL encoding.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
